h5Dungeon3rdAcidicHydra.description:
Hydras, Deep Hydras and Foul Hydras are the level 5 units of the Heroes V Dungeon (merged into Dungeon). All of them have {No Enemy Retaliation} and {Enrage} (Attack increases when an allied stack is destroyed). Hydras have {Three-Headed Attack} (attacks the enemies in the 3 hexes in front at once). Deep Hydras also have {Six-Headed Attack} (attacks all adjacent enemies) and {Vitality Regeneration} (restores 22–37 Hit Points at the start of each round). Foul Hydras also have {Acid Blood} (when attacked in melee, sprays acid 4 hexes toward the attacker, dealing 25% damage) and {Six-Headed Attack} (attacks all adjacent enemies).

Foul Hydras feed on the giant spiders of the caves, and this has changed the composition of their blood. Even a small wound makes their blood seethe, and acid gushes out in all directions like a fountain. So once wounded, a Foul Hydra repays its attackers with its own blood.

See also {Hydra}, {Deep Hydra}.

h5Dungeon3rdBlackRider.description:
Dark Raiders, Grim Raiders and Brisk Raiders are the level 4 units of the Heroes V Dungeon (merged into Dungeon). Dark Raiders have {Rider Charge} (-20% to the target's Defense for every hex moved in the charge). Grim Raiders have {Rider Charge} (-20% to the target's Defense for every hex moved in the charge) and {Lizard Bite} (joins in when an ally attacks an adjacent enemy, dealing 50% damage). Brisk Raiders have {Lizard Bite} (joins in when an ally attacks an adjacent enemy, dealing 50% damage) and {Ride-By Attack} (enemies beside the charge path take 25% damage).

Charging on fearsome lizards with tridents in hand, Brisk Raiders are the very image of the proud armies of the underworld. Their weapons have no weakness, and with their unstoppable momentum they cut down god and demon alike in their path.

See also {Dark Raider}, {Grim Raider}.

bonus.description:
{Steady Ranks}
Immune to charge damage bonuses

{Raid}
Returns to its position after attacking

h5Dungeon3rdBloodWitch2.description:
Blood Maidens, Blood Furies and Blood Sisters are the level 2 units of the Heroes V Dungeon (merged into Dungeon). All of them have {Strike and Return} (returns to its original position after attacking). Blood Furies also have {No Enemy Retaliation}. Blood Sisters also have {No Enemy Retaliation} and {Immune to Weakness} (immune to the Weakness curse).

Savage and reckless: that is the Blood Sister. Blood Sisters believe themselves invincible; they strike faster than any enemy and easily dodge their foes' blades.

See also {Blood Maiden}, {Blood Fury}.

returnAfterStrike.description:
{Strike and Return}

h5Dungeon3rdMinotaurCaptain.description:
Minotaurs, Minotaur Guards and Minotaur Taskmasters are the level 3 units of the Heroes V Dungeon (merged into Dungeon). Minotaurs have {Bravery} (Morale is always at least +1). Minotaur Guards have {Double Attack} (attacks twice) and {Bravery} (Morale is always at least +1). Minotaur Taskmasters have {Aura of Bravery} (adjacent allies always have at least +1 Morale).

Even slaves need leaders. The orders of Minotaur Taskmasters are obeyed even by the Dark Elves. Taskmasters know that on the battlefield a slave faces nothing but death, and only constant encouragement can make slaves brave.

See also {Minotaur}, {Minotaur Guard}.

{No Retaliation}

h5Dungeon3rdRedDragon.description:
Shadow Dragons, Black Dragons and Scarlet Dragons are the level 7 units of the Heroes V Dungeon (merged into Dungeon). All of them can fly, are dragons and have {Fire Breath} (the attack also hits the unit behind the target). Black Dragons also have {Magic Immunity} (immune to all magic). Scarlet Dragons also have {Incinerate} (deals 1.5 times damage to an adjacent enemy, which cannot retaliate).

Only a madman would dream of fighting a Scarlet Dragon. When they swoop down from the sky, merciless flames engulf everything on the battlefield, and survival is all but impossible. When Scarlet Dragons join the fight, there is no warrior whose blood does not run cold.

See also {Shadow Dragon}, {Black Dragon}.

bonus.description:
{No Retaliation}
Enemy cannot retaliate when attacked

{Immune to Berserk}

{Immune to Frost Ring}
Unaffected by Frost Ring

h5Dungeon3rdShadowMistress.description:
Shadow Witches, Shadow Matriarchs and Shadow Mistresses are the level 6 units of the Heroes V Dungeon (merged into Dungeon). All of them can cast {Slow}, {Armor Break} and {Righteous Might} (2 times per battle, 11 mana). Shadow Witches can shoot. Shadow Matriarchs can also shoot and have {Whip Strike} (melee attacks have a chance to cast Slow, Suffering or Berserk). Shadow Mistresses also have {Whip Strike} (melee attacks have a chance to cast Slow, Suffering or Berserk) and {Invisibility} (invisible for 3 rounds; its attacks cannot be retaliated against, and it is revealed after attacking).

Without exception, Dark Elves are captivated by the beauty of the Shadow Mistresses, yet they never risk speaking a single word to them, for it would bring them to ruin. These witches wield whips of fire, and remember: the lash is not reserved for the battlefield alone.

See also {Shadow Witch}, {Shadow Matriarch}.

{No Retaliation}

h5Dungeon3rdStalker.description:
Agents, Cutthroats and Stalkers are the level 1 units of the Heroes V Dungeon (merged into Dungeon). Agents can shoot and have {Shooting Penalty} (half damage when shooting, no melee penalty). Cutthroats can shoot and have {Shooting Penalty} (half damage when shooting, no melee penalty) and {Poisonous Attack} (poisons the target for 3 rounds, dealing 1 × the number of poisoners in damage each round). Stalkers have {Poisonous Attack} (poisons the target for 3 rounds, dealing 1 × the number of poisoners in damage each round) and {Invisibility} (invisible for 3 rounds; its attacks cannot be retaliated against, and it is revealed after attacking).

Dark Elves always hold Cutthroats in high esteem, but they revere even more the master killers who come and go without a trace and strike their targets without warning. These are the Stalkers, those who have grasped the secrets of the shadow ambush. Stalkers slip like ghosts through traps, spells and flashing blades, silently close in on the guards, and then strike the fatal blow.

See also {Agent}, {Cutthroat}.

{Immune to Blind}
Unaffected by Blind

h5DungeonAssassin.description:

Cutthroats can shoot and have {Shooting Penalty} (half damage when shooting, no melee penalty) and {Poisonous Attack} (poisons the target for 3 rounds, dealing 1 × the number of poisoners in damage each round). Stalkers have {Poisonous Attack} (poisons the target for 3 rounds, dealing 1 × the number of poisoners in damage each round) and {Invisibility} (invisible for 3 rounds; its attacks cannot be retaliated against, and it is revealed after attacking).

The main role of Cutthroats on the battlefield is to attack the enemy from range with deadly crossbows. Their magic bolts can gravely wound enemies and poison them.

See also {Agent}, {Stalker}.

Black Dragons are the older and more powerful kin of the Shadow Dragons. They not only possess all the abilities of Shadow Dragons but are even fiercer, and they are completely immune to magic.

Blood Furies are the elite warriors of the Dark Elf army. They can swiftly move up to an opponent, attack, and immediately return to their starting position. Blood Furies use this tactic so skillfully that the enemy has no time to react or retaliate.

h5DungeonDeepDragon.description:

Scarlet Dragons also have {Incinerate} (deals 1.5 times damage to an adjacent enemy, which cannot retaliate).

Shadow Dragons live in the dark corners deep underground. The Dark Elves worship them as incarnations of the Great Mother, and they occasionally help their worshippers. A single Shadow Dragon can be a truly formidable foe. Shadow Dragons breathe clouds of fire that can reduce even the most stubborn enemy to ashes in an instant.

See also {Black Dragon}, {Scarlet Dragon}.

Hydras are another underground creature tamed and enslaved by the Dark Elves. Although they look as if they might be related to dragons, they are in fact slow-witted and lack magic, and their origin is still unknown. See also {Deep Hydra}, {Foul Hydra}.

h5DungeonMinotaur.description:
Minotaurs, Minotaur Guards and Minotaur Taskmasters are the level 3 units of the Heroes V Dungeon (merged into Dungeon). Minotaurs have {Bravery} (Morale is always at least +1). Minotaur Guards have {Double Attack} (attacks twice) and {Bravery} (Morale is always at least +1). Minotaur Taskmasters have {Aura of Bravery} (adjacent allies always have at least +1 Morale).

Minotaurs were originally half-man, half-bull creatures created by the mages of the Seven Cities to replace the orcs. To win their freedom they fled east and hid underground. Later the Minotaurs were conquered by the Dark Elves and once again put in chains and muzzles. In Dark Elf society, Minotaurs are lowly laborers who do the most menial and monotonous work. Despite such treatment, Minotaurs remain true to their nature: brave and loyal. They give their all in everything, even shedding their blood on the battlefield for the Dark Elves who enslave them, in the hope of earning their freedom this way; what troubles the Dark Elves is that one day the Minotaurs may awaken on their own and seize their freedom by revolt.

See also {Minotaur Guard}, {Minotaur Taskmaster}.

Minotaur Guards have {Double Attack} (attacks twice) and {Bravery} (Morale is always at least +1). Minotaur Taskmasters have {Aura of Bravery} (adjacent allies always have at least +1 Morale).

Minotaur warriors who perform outstandingly receive advanced combat training and are promoted to Minotaur Guards. Covered in tattoos, they are skilled with deadly double-bladed axes and can deliver two heavy blows in a row.

See also {Minotaur}, {Minotaur Taskmaster}.

Grim Raiders resemble their slightly weaker kin, the Dark Raiders, but they are more skilled fighters, and their well-trained lizard mounts can bite enemies.

Grim Raiders have {Rider Charge} (-20% to the target's Defense for every hex moved in the charge) and {Lizard Bite} (joins in when an ally attacks an adjacent enemy, dealing 50% damage). Brisk Raiders have {Lizard Bite} (joins in when an ally attacks an adjacent enemy, dealing 50% damage) and {Ride-By Attack} (enemies beside the charge path take 25% damage).

Dark Raiders are the backbone of Ygg-Chall's army. These well-trained warriors carry lances, wear heavy armor and ride giant lizards into battle. Speed is their main weapon, and the damage of their lances depends on the distance of the charge.

See also {Grim Raider}, {Brisk Raider}.
